notes.title: Opinion and updates
notes.content:
For us, the players' opinion about this game is very important. This is our first project, and, despite its low popularity, we want to make it even better. [b] Please write reviews! [/b] This is very important for us at the moment! We will be able to find out exactly what the players lack, what to remove and what to replace. Also, due to reviews (the policy of Steam), we will able to release collection cards, backgrounds, emotions and more ...
   • Thank you for your attention, and very much thanks to those who wrote the review.
